conversation.message: That makes sense. What are some of the key differences between machine learning and deep learning?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Machine learning often requires human-engineered features, while deep learning uses neural networks to automatically learn features directly from data. conversation.message: So deep learning is like a more advanced form that handles more complex data?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
